limitations: Mobile 1.0.0 is frozen on web v0.26.0. Hero v0.28 and NPC v0.29 locomotion are not integrated. Do not label current native sources or prior AAB/archive as v0.29.
No native compilation or tests were rerun for this read-only inventory. Historical reports remain historical, and original source/package/build artifacts were not modified.
No signing keys, certificates, provisioning profiles, SDK paths, user browser profiles, login tokens, developer-account sessions, or production credentials are included.
Browser localStorage gameplay does not migrate merely by cloning. Native progress is installation-local; this inventory does not export personal save data.
The original package-source script refuses to replace an existing source ZIP; use a new transfer-package destination or separate transfer builder, not an in-place rerun.

The original verify-web script uses an absolute baseline sourceFolder. Full standalone verification additionally needs the listed baselines or a documented verifier adjustment in the transferred copy.
Store copy is draft metadata for the v0.26-based free offline build with no ads or real-money billing SDK. Any newer monetization plan needs separate implementation and disclosure updates.
Physical-device performance, memory, native touch/audio/orientation/lifecycle and Android 16KB runtime validation, distribution signing, submission and publication still require separate evidence.
